title: How To Command Belief Like a Cult Leader
description:
“Like a cult” means LIKE one… not actually one. If you want to use humans’ tribal, vision-craving purposes for good (like Berkshire Hathaway, Apple, Oura, etc), start here 👇

https://joannawiebe.co/cult-playbook

And you really should want this for your brand. After all, you've watched businesses with lesser products and absolutely no vision steal market share from you or from other brands you love. You’ve also wondered what you’re missing that some of these lasting, beloved brands have nailed. The answer: 

You need a congregation that believes in you. 

In this video, will show you how to build that — how to make anyone believe in you using the 6 belief triggers cult leaders and cult-like brands use to command devotion. 

I break down each one, from defining a shared "devil" worth fighting to building rituals and in-group language that turn customers into believers, using examples from Apple, Patagonia, and Berkshire Hathaway alongside the cult leaders who mastered these tactics (and don’t deserve to own them!). 

Belief in you is the most powerful force a leader can wield. And once you can manufacture it on purpose, you can change your career, your business — your life. If you’re a $20M - $50M business ready to figure this stuff out, book a consult 👇
https://joannawiebe.co/consultation

💬 Comment the brand or leader you'd follow anywhere (and why).
🔔 Subscribe for more on personal branding, influence, and building belief.
